name: winhelm-mcp
description: WinHelm - Windows Native MCP Server with Unified HTTP/SSE/Streamable Gateway and 38 System Tools
long_description: WinHelm is a lightweight, all-in-one MCP server designed for the Windows operating system. It embeds a native Streamable HTTP and SSE gateway, complete with Web Monitor, UTF-8 PowerShell runner, surgical file editor, Ripgrep search, PDF generation, clipboard, screen capture, and system inspection tools.

port.title: Server Port
port.description: Port on which the HTTP, SSE, and Streamable HTTP gateway listens.

host.title: Bind Host
host.description: Network host interface to bind (e.g. 0.0.0.0 for Tailscale/LAN, 127.0.0.1 for local only).

auth_token.title: Authentication Bearer Token
auth_token.description: Optional Bearer token required for all incoming requests.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Directories
allowed_directories.description: Comma-separated list of directories permitted for file operations (leave empty for unrestricted).
